## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (85%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section (resample severity 3) with four positive margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 85%, InSitu 15%, Benign/Normal 0% [F1] | Favors Invasive over InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%; dataset coverage 90%) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD, 12 tiles [F6] | Unflagged; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent models match top |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (similarity 0.70–0.81) [F5] | All neighbors match Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 9, 11) · context · High (+1.90); lowers invasive score (-1.72; 8/20 check) [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.93, +1.21); unreliable concept (0/20 check) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · High (+1.91, +1.08); unreliable weak concept (0/20 check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Low (-1.54, +1.07; caption inconsistent; 18/20 check) · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-1.29, +1.04; 20/20 check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion drops probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088–0.0064); relies on unreliable normal lobules, mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resample degradation (severity 3) on this simulated frozen section masks intact borders of InSitu carcinoma (15%).
- Dense TILs (regions 4, 9, 11) obscure InSitu ducts (contrast BACH_0063 is InSitu, similarity 0.65).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 4, 3**: Highest risk (100%, 100%, 99%); confirm stromal invasion over InSitu.
2. **Region 5**: Check tubule and stroma loss versus InSitu contrast BACH_0063.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Verify positive superior, inferior (538 um), medial (323 um), lateral margins.
